verses.text: The king's heart is in the LORD's hand like streams of water. He turns it wherever he wants.
People think everything they do is right, but the LORD weighs their hearts.
Doing what is right and fair pleases the LORD more than offering sacrifices.
Proud eyes and a proud heart, which are the lamp of the wicked, are sin.
The plans of hard-working people lead to profit, but everyone who is in too much of a hurry ends up poor.
Riches gained by lying are like a mist that blows away, and they lead to death.
The violence of the wicked will sweep them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
The path of guilty people is crooked, but the actions of innocent people are right.
It is better to live in a corner on the roof than to share a house with a quarrelling wife.
Wicked people long for evil. They show no mercy to their neighbours.
When a mocker is punished, simple people learn wisdom. When wise people are taught, they gain knowledge.
The Righteous One watches the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.
Whoever closes their ears to the cry of the poor will also cry out and not be answered.
A secret gift calms anger, and a bribe hidden in a coat calms great fury.
When justice is done, good people are glad, but evil people are terrified.
Whoever wanders from the path of understanding will end up resting among the dead.
Whoever loves pleasure will become poor. Whoever loves wine and rich food will never be rich.
The wicked become the price paid for good people, and the unfaithful for the honest.
It is better to live in a desert than with a quarrelling, complaining wife.
Wise people have precious treasure and oil stored in their homes, but foolish people use up everything they have.
Whoever chases after goodness and kindness will find life, goodness, and honour.
A wise person can attack a city defended by mighty warriors and pull down the fortress they trust in.
Whoever guards their mouth and tongue keeps themselves out of trouble.
A proud and arrogant person is called a mocker. They act with great pride.
A lazy person's wishes will kill him, because his hands refuse to work.
Some people are greedy all day long, but good people give without holding back.
The LORD hates the sacrifices of the wicked, especially when they bring them with evil motives.
A false witness will be destroyed, but whoever listens carefully will be heard forever.
Wicked people put on a bold face, but honest people think carefully about their ways.
No wisdom, no understanding, and no plan can succeed against the LORD.
A horse is made ready for the day of battle, but the victory belongs to the LORD.
